verdict.rationale: The v1 API reference states it lets you 'manage scan schedules,' implying recurring scan jobs can be configured programmatically, but there is no dedicated doc page, UI walkthrough, or example showing how to set cadence, or evidence this extends to broader 'workflows' beyond scanning. missing for 10: dedicated scheduling documentation/UI, example of setting recurring cadence, evidence of scheduling beyond scans (e.g., recurring triage/ticket workflows), independent confirmation it works as claimed.
